name: driver-scorecard
description: Driver Behavior & Safety Scorecard - runs the Express API and Next.js app together

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
